job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
Deploy Recruitment Group are seeking a Systems /Software Engineer for an initial 6 Month period 


The Role:

Integration and testing of the interfaces between supplier subsystems to the clients  ETCS OBU Trainguard 200 and to the UK Freight Electric, Diesel Electric/Diesel vehicles.

You will be required to integrate subsystems on Test and Integration rigs. 

Update the system with new software and test prior to release for Test Support. The Test team will troubleshoot the defects found.

Roll out, test and troubleshoot software updates to systems installed on the vehicles therefore although some remote working is possible, you will be required to work on-site in the integration and test lab, at installers vehicle depots

You will be expected to configure data on the ETCS OBU System and maintain bespoke newly developed software.

The role also requires responsibility for requirements capture, development, and implementation of a remote data networking solution.

Methods and Tools:

Experience in using C++, C# Java, Python, PHP, JavaScript, jQuery and shell scripting, Git, Jira, Bugzilla, OpenGL, IBM DOORS
VOIP packet level diagnostics
Networking: (BIND/dnsmasq, dhcpd, tftp, OpenVPN)
Custom Linux systems server to embedded applications
Serial BUS analysis (RS485, MVB)

Experience:

Rail Vehicle Acceptance Testing, Instrumentation and Software Development
Railway signalling, OTMR, TPWS, ETCS
Experience of regulatory standards
Development of Safety related software
Design/Integration for RIA12 and EN 50155
Competence in Software Clearing

Qualifications:

BEng Computer Science/Software Engineering/Electrical & Electronic Engineering

job.title: Project Engineering Manager (Train Systems)
job.description:
Senior Project Engineer / Project Engineering Manager
Freight ETCS | Derby | Rail
We are looking for a Senior Project Engineer / Project Engineering Manager to join a major Freight ETCS programme, providing technical direction and support to Project Engineers working across the project.
The Freight ETCS project supports the rollout of ETCS Onboard solutions across the UK freight locomotive fleet, with locomotives at different stages of the project lifecycle. This includes design, first-in-class installation, fleet production and type testing.
This is an opportunity to play an important role within the ETCS Onboard Engineering team, helping to ensure engineering activities and deliverables are understood, planned and delivered in line with project requirements and schedules.
Key Responsibilities
  • Play a lead role within the ETCS Onboard Engineering team, ensuring project-related engineering deliverables are understood and implemented in line with project schedules.
  • Provide direction and support to Project Engineers working across the project.
  • Ensure the engineering team develops and monitors engineering plans, reporting progress against budget and timeline.
  • Identify issues and potential delays and take proactive and decisive action where required.
  • Work closely with the Head of Engineering and Work Package Managers to support efficient project and engineering delivery.
  • Promote engineering excellence through consistent practices and the identification and adoption of improved processes, tools and ways of working.
  • Review engineering requirements and provide written comments and feedback as required.
  • Participate in engineering and technical reviews.
  • Review engineering deliverables to ensure they are complete, consistent and meet project requirements.
  • Work with subcontractors and fitment partners throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support the delivery of engineering activities associated with the installation, testing and commissioning of modified rail vehicles.
  • Maintain a strong focus on customer requirements, quality and safety throughout all engineering activities.
Essential Experience & Qualifications
  • In-depth practical knowledge and experience of the design and installation of onboard train systems, typically including ETCS, TPWS/AWS, GSM-R, Wi-Fi, CCTV and/or DAS.
  • A proven track record of delivering installation and/or testing and commissioning projects associated with modifications to rail vehicles.
  • A tenacious and delivery-focused approach to technical work packages within a complex project environment.
  • Experience working with others to deliver a range of engineering work packages.
  • Knowledge of rail depot procedures and site safety.
  • Ability to read and review engineering requirements, provide written comments and participate in reviews as required.
  • Experience reviewing engineering deliverables for completeness and consistency.
  • Previous experience liaising with subcontractors throughout the full project lifecycle.
  • A strong customer focus in all work undertaken.
  • Experience working to industry quality and safety standards.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels within the business and with new and existing customers.
  • Highly motivated, dependable and self-reliant.
  • Willingness and ability to work from Derby three days per week, with flexibility to travel to fitment partner locations across the Midlands.
Desirable Experience
  • Understanding of freight locomotives.
  • Knowledge and/or experience of implementing Onboard ETCS solutions.
  • Experience working in an operational and/or maintenance environment.
  • A proven track record of working within major subcontractor environments.
  • Experience reviewing product installation designs to ensure adherence to guidelines and installation constraints.
  • An understanding of the approvals process required to modify a train and bring it back into service.
The Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced rail engineer to take on a key role within a major Freight ETCS programme.
You'll be working alongside an experienced Engineering team and supporting the delivery of complex onboard rail systems across different stages of the project lifecycle. The role offers the opportunity to combine strong technical engineering experience with responsibility for coordinating and supporting project engineering delivery.
If you have experience delivering rail vehicle modification projects and a strong understanding of onboard rail systems, we'd like to hear from you.

job.description:
Location: Heathrow Airport, Terminal 2
Project Value: £150 million
Sector: Aviation | M&E | Infrastructure

Long-term contract, outside IR35. 

Lead the Delivery of a Landmark Infrastructure Project

We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Construction Manager to join the team delivering one of the UK's most prestigious aviation infrastructure projects.

This role offers the opportunity to lead the electrical construction delivery of the £150 million M&E installation, commissioning and systems integration for a state-of-the-art baggage handling system at Heathrow Airport Terminal 2. This flagship programme will enhance one of the world's busiest airports, delivering cutting-edge technology and critical infrastructure that will serve millions of passengers each year.

If you're passionate about delivering complex engineering projects and thrive in high-profile, technically challenging environments, we'd like to hear from you.

The Role

As Senior Electrical Construction Manager, you will take ownership of the electrical construction works from installation through commissioning and handover, ensuring delivery is safe, efficient and to the highest quality standards.

Working closely with project directors, engineers, subcontractors and the client team, you will play a pivotal role in driving programme performance and successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead all electrical construction activities across the project.
  • Manage subcontractors, supervisors and site teams.
  • Ensure works are delivered safely, on programme and within budget.
  • Coordinate installation, testing, commissioning and systems integration activities.
  • Drive quality assurance and ensure compliance with project specifications.
  • Chair coordination and progress meetings with stakeholders.
  • Identify and mitigate construction risks and technical issues.
  • Monitor programme milestones and resource requirements.
  • Build strong working relationships with the client, consultants and project partners.
  • Champion best practice in health, safety and environmental performance.
About You

You'll be a proven construction leader with experience delivering large-scale electrical or MEP projects within highly regulated or mission-critical environments.

You'll ideally have experience in sectors such as:

  • Airports
  • Data centres
  • Rail
  • Major infrastructure
  • Industrial or manufacturing facilities
  • Automated logistics or baggage handling systems

You'll also have:

  • Extensive experience managing electrical construction on major projects.
  • Strong knowledge of installation, commissioning and electrical systems integration.
  • Excellent leadership and stakeholder management skills.
  • A collaborative approach with the ability to motivate multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong commercial and programme awareness.
  • Commitment to delivering the highest standards of safety and quality.
Qualifications
  • HNC/HND or Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline (preferred).
  • SMSTS.
  • ECS/CSCS Card.
  • First Aid (desirable).
  • Full UK driving licence.
Why Join Us?

This is a rare opportunity to play a leading role on one of the UK's highest-profile infrastructure programmes.

You'll work alongside some of the industry's leading engineering professionals, delivering a technically advanced baggage handling system that will become a key part of Heathrow Airport's future operations.

Apply to Andrew Snelgrove at Deploy.

job.title: HV Engineer
job.description:
Company that specialises in high voltage (HV) systems up to 33kV, requires an HV Engineer to join their friendly, busy and growing team.

Experts in the installation, commissioning, fault-finding, testing and maintenance of HV equipment, including switchgear and transformers, the organisation has a reputation for offering its people excellent training and development opportunities and is recognised within the industry as a great place to work.

The HV Engineer role is a hands-on job, with frequent site visits. Duties will include:
  • Maintaining electrical equipment (LV, 11kV and 33kV), such as protection relays, transformers and switchgear
  • Fault-finding on LV and HV equipment and responding to emergency call outs
  • Interpreting electrical schematics and drawings
  • Carrying out isolations and Authorised Person (AP) / Senior Authorised Person (SAP) duties when qualified to do so 
  • The issue and acceptance of Permits to Work (PTW) for the safe operation of HV systems
  • Carrying out site surveys
  • Testing, commissioning and maintenance of HV equipment
  • Carrying out all duties in accordance with health and safety legislation 
  • Representing the company on site
Qualifications and Experience Required:
  • Knowledge and hands on experience working on HV systems
  • The ability to use HV testing equipment
  • Demonstrable knowledge of electrical safety rules and isolations
  • Qualification in Electrical Engineering, eg. HNC
  • Driving licence 
  • Whilst most work is within 80 miles of the office, some is further afield so a willingness to travel and, occasionally, stay away is required
  • Problem-solving and communication skills
This exciting opportunity is ideal for someone with experience in the installation, maintenance or commissioning of HV systems. It's especially suitable for an HV Engineer who wants to benefit from excellent training and a path to Senior Authorised Person status, with a company that values its people. 

Apply to Andrew Snelgrove at Deploy.

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer
job.description:

The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for the design of new connections and network improvements on both low voltage and high voltage systems, covering:
  • Studies and analysis of LV networks, including fault levels, voltage drop and network loading
  • LV and HV cable and overhead line (OHL) design for reinforcements, replacements, connections and diversions on the underground and overhead networks
  • Liaison with external customers / stakeholders

Requirements:
  • Previous experience as an Electrical Design Engineer for LV or HV schemes
  • Qualification in Electrical Engineering (or related subject)
  • Understanding of DNO, NERS and ERA requirements (beneficial)
  • Driving licence (essential)
Great opportunity for long-term employment and career development. Apply to Andrew Snelgrove at Deploy.

job.title: Control and Protection Engineer
job.description:
Opportunity available for an HV Design Engineer with control and protection experience to join a respected consultancy working on projects for TSOs, DNOs and in renewable energy.

Working with a team of high voltage sector experts, the focus of the role is to support the development of HV substation projects, across both transmission and distribution voltage levels. 

Designing control and protection systems, responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and reviewing design documents, such as protection schemes and philosophies, protection settings and coordination studies, single line diagrams (SLDs), schematics, and wiring diagrams, interlocking and tripping logic
  • Specifying and selecting protection relays
  • Carrying out protection grading studies and fault studies, using ETAP, DigSILENT, PSCAD etc
  • Ensuring designs comply with industry standards
  • Liaising with internal teams (design, construction, commissioning) and external parties
  • Assisting with the preparation of design risk assessments, design changes and answering technical queries

Previous experience in control & protection design is required, at either 11kV, 33kV, 66kV, 132kV or 400kV. A driving licence is also essential. 

With a considerable portfolio of works to deliver, and a surrounded by a supportive team of HV design experts, this is an excellent opportunity for a Protection and Control Engineer. Apply to Andrew Snelgrove at Deploy.
